params.description: Ordered params: empty; this slot has no effect.
Ordered params: Drive (dimensionless input gain before tanh); Mix (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).
Ordered params: Samples (delay in audio sample frames, not ms; truncated after runtime ring-safe clamping); Feedback (linear delayed-signal gain into the ring); Mix (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).

Ordered params: Rate Hz (internal sine modulation cycles/second, not period_ms); Depth (sample frames added as depth*(0.5+0.5*sin(phase)) to an 11 ms base delay, runtime ring-safe clamped); Mix (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).

Ordered params: Room (dimensionless Freeverb control, comb feedback=0.7+0.28*Room); Damping (dimensionless control, one-pole previous-state coefficient=0.4*Damping); Wet (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).

Ordered params: Threshold (positive linear peak amplitude, not dB); Ratio (dimensionless compression ratio, gain=(Threshold/envelope)^(1-1/Ratio) above threshold); Attack and Release (per-sample previous-envelope coefficients, not durations: envelope=(1-c)*peak+c*previous, c chosen on rising/falling peak; 0 immediate, values nearer 1 slower; for 0<c<1, time constant seconds=-1/(sample_rate*ln(c))); Makeup (linear output gain, not dB).

Ordered params: Lowpass Hz then Highpass Hz (cutoff frequencies, not coefficients; nonpositive disables that edge, positive values round to integer Hz and clamp to [1,sample_rate/2-1]; runtime generates FIR taps).

audio_next.description: Explicit outgoing successors for payload slots 0..3 then Input: 0 absent, 1..4 slot+1, 5 Output. Unused/none source entries must be zero; destinations must name real slots or Output. All fragments must be acyclic with unique incoming and outgoing endpoints. Only a complete Input-to-Output path plays; incomplete paths bypass dry. All four retained payloads reserve existing budgets.

title: Portable effects chain
description: Self-contained retained effects collection. v1 is implicit serial order; v2 requires explicit audio_next topology, preserving detached effects and layout.  LFO ids are one-based array identities, not hashes; slot ids are zero-based and include none slots.  Required LFO wave and period_ms have no valid omitted default; other omitted scalar fields default to zero, add, or none (enabled defaults to false), not the editor's new-effect presets.  Layout identities must be unique and reference a real effect or existing LFO.  Unconnected represented LFOs are retained.  Master Paste strips parameter MIDI inputs, LFO MIDI sources and midi layout only.  FIR coefficients and audio state are generated at runtime.  Documents must fit 65535 UTF-8 bytes and 8192 parser tokens, and the resulting complete bank must fit descriptor, graph, modulation and effect-state budgets.  Schema conformance alone cannot express full runtime validation: the production decoder and destination-bank validation must also accept the document.  Unknown or duplicate keys refuse.  No custom titles.
